prose: The accessible opening of an Upstarts report says Imprint raised $130 million at a $1.88 billion valuation for its co-branded credit-card business. It reports more than two million cardholders and expected annual GAAP revenue of about $400 million, with management emphasizing growth faster than staffing. The article's deeper discussion of loyalty and agentic commerce is subscriber-only and was not available in the fetched text.
highlights: Co-branded cards remain the core business
basis: Accessible article introduction and Techmeme feed; remainder requires subscription.
